svg.text: Proposed design. First-order budgets; no hardware exists.
Two roll-out blanket wings (Redwire ROSA class)
2 x 1.1 x 5.0 m, 11 m2, fixed sun-facing
ROSA Diamond class, flown on DART
2.5 kWh lithium-ion (eclipse season and safe mode)
~450 J per 1 ms pump pulse, ~0.4 MW peak
2 x 600 W Xe Hall thrusters (prime + redundant)
24 kg Xe in 25 L COPV; 8.8 kg disposal reserve locked
Delta-v budget 570 m/s incl. 273 m/s disposal
Plume cone +X; nothing sensitive ahead of exit plane
4 x 4 N m s reaction wheels (pyramid), isolated bench
2 star trackers, FOG IMU, fine sun sensors
Dual GNSS: 1 PPS to laser timing & crosslink
S-band CCSDS TT&C, zenith + nadir patches
X-band downlink 140 Mbps: imagery + firing log
L-band GEO relay: anytime command / abort
1030 nm, 45 J per pulse, 10 Hz, 1 ns
Diode-pumped (976 nm QCW stacks on cold plates)
Nearest lab analogue: HiLASE Bivoj / DiPOLE100
20 J UV per pulse, 10 Hz, 200 W average
Bivoj THG: 50-55 J @ 10 Hz @ 343 nm demonstrated
Beam rises through hollow azimuth axis,
0.45 m SiC primary (Mersen Boostec class, ~5 kg)
Cassegrain afocal expander, HfO2/SiO2 UV coatings
2-axis yoke gimbal in aft cradle: az +/-100, el -25/+70 deg
Inertial reference unit on tube (LCRD heritage)
Contamination door, O2 bleed at exposed optics (ALADIN)
15 cm acquisition telescope, 1.5 deg, V~15 (SBV class)
LWIR camera on gimbal for eclipse tracking
Catalogue + angles-only navigation from 100s of km
Track confirmed; protected objects > 0.1 deg off axis beyond target;
Laser Clearinghouse window open; limb > 100 km below line of sight
Mechanically pumped loop from laser cold plates
2 deployable radiators 2.0 x 0.85 m, two-sided: 6.8 m2
Body OSR radiator on anti-sun face: 0.9 m2
Net 344 W/m2; louvers on electronics radiator
Head-on from 5-12 km ahead; 2.8 cm spot at 10 km
Energy on target 98 W (0.7 pointing x 0.7 surface)
10 kg fragment: 164 m/s in ~9 days at 45 % duty
Loiters 50 km below the 800 km target band:
J2 drift 7.9 deg/yr walks between target planes free
Fire only on targets approaching from ahead
Disposal: EP spiral to 300 km, 43 days; FCC 5-yr rule
Array EOL 3050 W; thruster not run while firing
Body 1.0 x 0.95 x 0.85 m inside the Moog Grande envelope;
stowed with appendages 1.33 x 1.23 x 1.12 m (XL-volume slot)
Port qualified to 700 kg; wet mass 486 kg
SpaceX rideshare XL plate: 300 kg included, more purchasable
Deployed: 10.9 m along nadir-zenith, 3.2 m across radiators
Wings roll out along +/-Z; radiators hinge off anti-sun face
NEA / Frangibolt HDRMs on wings, radiators, gimbal, door
Dissimilar metals + MoS2 at every separable contact
Highest avg optical power flown: ~25 W (CATS, ISS)
Highest UV flown: ~3.5 W (Aeolus ALADIN, 355 nm)
Ground: Bivoj THG 50-55 J @ 10 Hz @ 343 nm (ns)
Laser is the critical-path development item.
ESPA-Grande bus core, ROSA arrays, 600 W Hall
Pathfinder exists to measure impulse per joule
on real tumbling debris and UV optics ageing.
Population Mars / OrbitFleet. Sources, vendor candidates and verification status: docs/shepherd-1/README.md
